name: performance-size-maintainability-refactor

scope: whole-project refactor (parent; children: dependency-toolchain-health, release-size-per-abi, dart-architecture-convergence, native-rust-hygiene, interaction-visual-modernization, spec-test-lint-hardening)
creator: Lopution
